purpose: Additional-model exploratory trials on the same frozen historical cases; not a repeated-run ranking
userSelectedScope: Continue testing other models; default three additional models unless user steers scope before dispatch
budgetEnforcement: Coordinator monitors task_started and interrupts over-budget runs
inputPresentation: Frozen task prompt repeated verbatim in each initial task message; identical explicit UTF-8 reading instruction for all participants
differenceFromPilot1: Task and verifier bytes are unchanged. Inline task presentation and explicit UTF-8 reading guidance reduce the observed Windows decoding confound; these runs must not be presented as fully identical-condition repeats of pilot-1.
network: Only local fixtures and loopback during trials; dependencies provisioned before timing
performanceMeasurements: Each B02 participant and its independent grader run without another benchmark job competing for CPU; unchanged seven alternating baseline/candidate pairs
review: First submission only; preserve raw machine results; source-grounded document review and execution evidence review by coordinating Agent, not human review
futureComparison: Do not infer stable success rates or a winner from one run per case; repeated trials require their own preregistered protocol
